args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks – rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. v2.3.1 was also unhealthy in staging as v2.3.1-rc. Action taken: rolled checkout-api back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, the service is healthy on v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an error rate of 0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it, and check why it went out after failing in staging.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **Problem:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- **Version chosen:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. The release before v2.3.1 was its test version, v2.3.1-rc, which only ran in staging and was unhealthy there too, so I skipped it.
- **Rollback:** All three regions now run v2.3.0. The service reports healthy, and the error rate is down to about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2). There were no open incidents for this beforehand, so it isn't a duplicate. It records what failed, the rollback and the result. It also lists next steps: find what broke in v2.3.1, and check why it went to production after failing in staging.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
